summary: Allow prepared IVM pages to bound input separately from output and evidence

replay.detail: No startup replay or automatic installation. Existing prepare_live callers retain their prior input limits.

schema.detail: No persistent schema change. Slice tables and capture triggers exist only in isolated file-backed Store tests.

rules.detail: No native admission, authority, canonical order, retention or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Additive prepare_live_bounded method; original prepare_live delegates with the same row and byte limits. No production provider, worker or consumer is enabled.

downtime.detail: No deployment or runtime mode switch.

manual.detail: No database action, new collector or automatic background scheduling.

recovery.detail: Existing atomic prepared publication behavior is unchanged; failure-qualified writer exit and production source lifetime remain separate prerequisites.
